# Module 14：ATAC 交付与当前状态

只导出 ATAC 模块。已有产物的存在不等于本次重算；源表签名及运行记录决定当前资格。

```{r atac_summary_manifest}
active_names <- unname(step_output_dirs)
files <- list.files(result_dir, recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE)
files <- files[file.info(files)$isdir %in% FALSE]
relative_files <- substring(files, nchar(result_dir) + 2L)
module_names <- vapply(strsplit(relative_files, "/", fixed = TRUE), `[`, character(1), 1L)
keep <- module_names %in% active_names & !grepl("^14_export_summary_manifest/", relative_files)
files <- files[keep]; relative_files <- relative_files[keep]; module_names <- module_names[keep]
manifest <- data.frame(Module = module_names, Path = relative_files, Bytes = file.info(files)$size,
                       SHA256 = vapply(files, function(p) digest::digest(file = p, algo = "sha256"), character(1)),
                       Status = "PRESERVED_OUTPUT_UNVERIFIED_CURRENT_SIGNATURE", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
save_step_table(manifest, "Step14", "Result_Manifest.csv")
source_audit <- read_step_table("Step5", "Differential_Peak_Source_Audit.csv")
same_signature <- nrow(source_audit) > 0 && "AnalysisSignature" %in% names(source_audit) &&
  identical(as.character(source_audit$AnalysisSignature[1]), current_analysis_signature)
save_step_table(data.frame(Module = active_names,
  UpstreamStatus = if(same_signature) "CURRENT_SIGNATURE_VERIFIED" else "UNVERIFIED_CURRENT_SIGNATURE",
  Note = "仅列出本组学产物；旧产物不因整理目录而成为新结果。"), "Step14", "Current_Result_Status.csv")
summary_lines <- c("# ATAC 结果入口", "", paste0("比较方向：", contrast_label), "",
  "- 差异开放：05_differential_accessibility", "- 注释与富集：07_peak_gene_enrichment",
  "- Motif 与足迹：08_motif_activity、09_footprinting_tf_evidence",
  "- 候选与位点：13_keygenes_locus_reports", "",
  "跨组织、跨组学解释由独立联合入口提供。请先检查 Current_Result_Status.csv 的来源状态。")
writeLines(summary_lines, step_table_file("Step14", "README.md"), useBytes = TRUE)
```
